datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: In this study, an open source named Bijie landslide dataset has been used to automatically detect landslides by the DL method [16]... An image sample from the Bijie landslide dataset, which is available at http://study.rsgis.whu.edu.cn/pages/download/, has been presented in Fig. 2.

datasets.name: ImageNet database
datasets.verbatim: VGG-16 [31] is a state-of-the-art DL model pre-trained with over 1 million images from the ImageNet database.

methods.name: Ensemble learning method
methods.summary: The method combines predictions from multiple pre-trained CNN models (Custom CNN, VGG-16, VGG-19, Inception-V3, Xception, DenseNet-121, MobileNet, and NASNet-mobile) using ensemble strategies such as majority vote, simple averaging, weighted averaging, and stacking to improve landslide classification and localization performance. It also utilizes Class-selective relevance mapping (CRM) to visualize and interpret the learned behaviors of individual models and their ensembles for ROI localization.
